how_to_apply: Prepare a brief bio-data duly signed and download the application form from the official website.
Gather proof of date of birth, BE/B.Tech, and ME/M.Tech mark sheets and degree certificates.
Merge all documents into a single PDF file.
Send the PDF application via email to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
Mention the subject title as "Application for Senior Project Associate (SPA)" in the email.
Ensure the application reaches on or before 21 October 2026.
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary for 01 year or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. Offer of Senior Project Associate (SPA) position does not confer any right for absorption in DIAT, Pune. Qualifications and experience gained should have been obtained from recognized Universities/Institutions/Industries. The Principal Investigator may restrict the number of candidates called for interview in case of a large number of applications. Selected candidates are required to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer letter. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Recruited Fellows shall be encouraged to register for a Ph.D. at this institute through proper channels as per DIAT norms.

Gather proof of date of birth, BE/B.Tech, and ME/M.Tech mark sheets and degree certificates. Merge all documents into a single PDF file. content_sections.text: Signed brief bio-data Application form Proof of Date of Birth BE / B.Tech mark sheets and degree certificates M.E / M.Tech mark sheets and degree certificates Supporting documents for research experience and publications Original documents along with 1 set of self-attested copies at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: DIAT Senior Project Associate Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary for 01 year or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. Offer of Senior Project Associate (SPA) position does not confer any right for absorption in DIAT, Pune. Qualifications and experience gained should have been obtained from recognized Universities/Institutions/Industries. The Principal Investigator may restrict the number of candidates called for interview in case of a large number of applications. Selected candidates are required to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer letter. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Recruited Fellows shall be encouraged to register for a Ph.D. at this institute through proper channels as per DIAT norms.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT), Pune.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Senior Project Associate (SPA).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.E./M. Tech in polymer Engg./ Nanoscience & Nanotechnology/ Metallurgical Engg./ Materials Science/ Mechanical Engg. or equivalent with 03 years of research experience and one publication in the SCI journal.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years as on 21 October 2026, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly stipend offered?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend payable is ₹42,000/- plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their signed bio-data, application form, and supporting documents as a single PDF to the email ID [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected through an interview conducted in person or via video conferencing.
